get.description: Returns a page of completed calls (CDR). Filters are passed as query parameters and are AND-combined; array filters are repeated query parameters combined with OR. Timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC); ranges are inclusive. Results are limited to the caller's domain and to calls visible under RBAC (own calls, supervised users, permitted queues and groups). Use the POST variant for large filter sets.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1-based. Combined with `size` to compute the offset. If omitted or 0, the first page is returned. The response field `next` indicates whether another page exists.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum number of calls returned per page. If omitted or 0, the server default page size is used (40); server maximum supported limit is 20000.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Quick search. Case-insensitive pattern match (ILIKE) against the dialed destination, the caller number (from_number) and the callee number (to_number), OR an exact match against the call ID (UUID). If omitted or empty, no text filtering is applied.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort expression: a response field name, optionally prefixed with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-created_at`). If omitted, the server default ordering is used (newest first).

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Response field projection: names of HistoryCall fields to return. If omitted or empty, all fields are returned. Requesting fewer fields reduces payload size and query cost.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Array of user IDs (OR logic). Matches calls where the user is the owner of the leg (`user_id`) OR participated in any leg of the call (`user_ids`). Use `owner_id` to match the leg owner only. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Array of agent IDs (OR logic). Matches calls handled by at least one of the given agents on any leg (`agent_ids`). Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: queue_id
parameters.description: Array of queue IDs (OR logic). Matches calls whose leg queue (`queue_id`) or any queue the call passed through (`queue_ids`) is in the list. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: Array of team IDs (OR logic). Matches calls whose leg team (`team_id`) or any team involved in the call (`team_ids`) is in the list. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: Array of queue member (contact/lead) IDs (OR logic). Exact match on the call's `member_id`. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: gateway_id
parameters.description: Array of SIP gateway (trunk) IDs (OR logic). Matches calls whose leg gateway (`gateway_id`) or any gateway used in the call (`gateway_ids`) is in the list. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: skip_parent
parameters.description: If true, only top-level calls (Leg A, `parent_id` is null) are returned and child legs (Leg B) are hidden. If false or omitted, all legs are returned.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Exact match on the parent call ID. Returns the direct child legs (Leg B) of the given call. If omitted or empty, no filter is applied.

parameters.name: cause
parameters.description: Array of hangup causes (OR logic), exact match on `cause` (e.g. NORMAL_CLEARING, USER_BUSY, NO_ANSWER, ORIGINATOR_CANCEL). Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: has_file
parameters.description: Tri-state filter by attached files (recordings, screen captures). true = only calls that have files; false = only calls without files; omitted/null = no filter.

parameters.name: domain_id
parameters.description: Tenant (domain) ID. Normally derived from the caller's authentication context; the server always restricts results to the caller's domain.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Phone number search. The value is converted to a regular expression and matched (`~`) against the pre-computed search number, or against destination, from_number and to_number when it is not available. Matches the number on either side of the call. If omitted or empty, no filter is applied.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Call direction, exact match: `inbound` or `outbound`. If omitted or empty, both directions are returned.

parameters.name: missed
parameters.description: If true, returns only missed calls: inbound, never bridged to an operator (`bridged_at` is null), not hidden from the missed list, and whose parent call was not bridged. Omit for no filter; do not send an explicit false.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Array of call IDs (UUID, OR logic). Exact match on `id`. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: transfer_from
parameters.description: Array of call IDs (UUID, OR logic). Returns calls that were created by a transfer FROM one of the given calls (`transfer_from`). Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: transfer_to
parameters.description: Array of call IDs (UUID, OR logic). Returns calls that were transferred TO one of the given calls (`transfer_to`). Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: dependency_id
parameters.description: Root call ID (UUID). Returns the full dependency tree of the call: all descendants reachable recursively through `parent_id` (child legs) or `transfer_from` (transfers). The root call itself is excluded. Required when `timeline` is true. If omitted, no filter is applied.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Array of tags (OR logic). Matches calls having at least one of the given tags (array overlap). Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: variables[string]
parameters.description: This is a request variable of the map type. The query format is "map_name[key]=value", e.g. If the map name is Age, the key type is string, and the value type is integer, the query parameter is expressed as Age["bob"]=18

parameters.name: amd_result
parameters.description: Array of answering machine detection (AMD) results (OR logic). Matches either the classic AMD result or the AI AMD result. Passing an empty string element ("") additionally matches calls without a detection result. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: fts
parameters.description: Full-text search over call transcripts (PostgreSQL plainto_tsquery semantics: all words must be present, order-insensitive). Implicitly requires the call to have a transcript. Ignored when `has_transcript` is false. If omitted or empty, no filter is applied.

parameters.name: directions
parameters.description: Array of call directions (`inbound`, `outbound`). Not applied by the GetHistoryByGroups query; use the singular `direction` field for direction filtering.

parameters.name: has_transcript
parameters.description: Tri-state filter by transcript presence. true = only calls with a transcript (further narrowed by `fts` if set); false = only calls without a transcript; omitted/null = no filter (unless `fts` is set).

parameters.name: agent_description
parameters.description: Case-insensitive pattern search (ILIKE) in the agent's wrap-up description of the queue attempt OR in any call annotation note. If omitted or empty, no filter is applied.

parameters.name: owner_id
parameters.description: Array of user IDs (OR logic). Matches calls where the given user is the direct owner of the leg (`user_id`) only; unlike `user_id`, participation in other legs is not considered. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: grantee_id
parameters.description: Array of grantee IDs (OR logic): the authorization subject (user/role/gateway identity) that the call was placed on behalf of. Exact match on `grantee_id`. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: amd_ai_result
parameters.description: Array of AI-based answering machine detection results (OR logic). Matched against `amd_ai_result` in lowercase. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: rated
parameters.description: Tri-state filter by quality evaluation. false = only calls that have NOT been evaluated; true = only evaluated calls, optionally narrowed by `rated_user`, `rated_by`, `score_required` and `score_optional`. Setting any of those filters without `rated` also restricts results to evaluated calls. Omitted/null = no filter.

parameters.name: rated_by
parameters.description: Array of user IDs of evaluators (supervisors/QA) who created the evaluation (OR logic). Restricts to evaluated calls. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: rated_user
parameters.description: Array of user IDs of the evaluated agents/operators (OR logic). Restricts to evaluated calls. Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: contact_id
parameters.description: Array of CRM contact IDs (OR logic). Exact match on the call's linked contact (`contact_id`). Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: schema_id
parameters.description: Array of routing schema (call flow / IVR) IDs (OR logic). Matches calls that executed at least one of the given schemas (array overlap on `schema_ids`). Empty array = no filter.

parameters.name: has_transfer
parameters.description: Tri-state filter by transfers. true = only calls involved in a blind or attended transfer; false = only calls with no transfer; omitted/null = no filter.

parameters.name: timeline
parameters.description: If true, returns only the legs relevant for building a call timeline of the call tree given by `dependency_id`: transferred legs handled by a user, blind transfer legs, and legs whose parent differs from the root. REQUIRES `dependency_id`; without it the result is empty. Omitted/null = no filter.

parameters.name: excluded_queue_types
parameters.description: Array of queue types to EXCLUDE from the result. Calls whose queue type is in the list are hidden; calls that did not pass through a queue are always kept. Empty array = nothing excluded.

post.description: Same semantics as the GET variant, but filters are sent in the JSON body. Recommended for large ID lists, variables maps and other filter sets that may exceed URL length limits.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Filter, sort and pagination parameters for searching completed calls (CDR). Filters are AND-combined; array filters are OR-combined internally. Timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC); ranges are inclusive.

post.summary:

Group and aggregate metrics like average duration, call counts, or peak hours.

patch.summary: PatchHistoryCall updates metadata for a completed call (e.g., variables or visibility).

page.description: Page number, 1-based. Combined with `size` to compute the offset. If omitted or 0, the first page is returned. The response field `next` indicates whether another page exists.

size.description: Maximum number of calls returned per page. If omitted or 0, the server default page size is used (40); server maximum supported limit is 20000.

q.description: Quick search. Case-insensitive pattern match (ILIKE) against the dialed destination, the caller number (from_number) and the callee number (to_number), OR an exact match against the call ID (UUID). If omitted or empty, no text filtering is applied.

sort.description: Sort expression: a response field name, optionally prefixed with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-created_at`). If omitted, the server default ordering is used (newest first).

fields.description: Response field projection: names of HistoryCall fields to return. If omitted or empty, all fields are returned. Requesting fewer fields reduces payload size and query cost.

created_at.description: Range filter (inclusive) on call creation time (`created_at`), Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC). Either bound may be omitted for an open-ended range. Strongly recommended for performance on large datasets.

user_id.description: Array of user IDs (OR logic). Matches calls where the user is the owner of the leg (`user_id`) OR participated in any leg of the call (`user_ids`). Use `owner_id` to match the leg owner only. Empty array = no filter.

agent_id.description: Array of agent IDs (OR logic). Matches calls handled by at least one of the given agents on any leg (`agent_ids`). Empty array = no filter.

queue_id.description: Array of queue IDs (OR logic). Matches calls whose leg queue (`queue_id`) or any queue the call passed through (`queue_ids`) is in the list. Empty array = no filter.

team_id.description: Array of team IDs (OR logic). Matches calls whose leg team (`team_id`) or any team involved in the call (`team_ids`) is in the list. Empty array = no filter.

member_id.description: Array of queue member (contact/lead) IDs (OR logic). Exact match on the call's `member_id`. Empty array = no filter.

gateway_id.description: Array of SIP gateway (trunk) IDs (OR logic). Matches calls whose leg gateway (`gateway_id`) or any gateway used in the call (`gateway_ids`) is in the list. Empty array = no filter.

duration.description: Range filter (inclusive) on total call duration in SECONDS (hangup time minus creation time, includes ringing/wait). A bound that is omitted or 0 is ignored.

skip_parent.description: If true, only top-level calls (Leg A, `parent_id` is null) are returned and child legs (Leg B) are hidden. If false or omitted, all legs are returned.

parent_id.description: Exact match on the parent call ID. Returns the direct child legs (Leg B) of the given call. If omitted or empty, no filter is applied.

cause.description: Array of hangup causes (OR logic), exact match on `cause` (e.g. NORMAL_CLEARING, USER_BUSY, NO_ANSWER, ORIGINATOR_CANCEL). Empty array = no filter.

has_file.description: Tri-state filter by attached files (recordings, screen captures). true = only calls that have files; false = only calls without files; omitted/null = no filter.

domain_id.description: Tenant (domain) ID. Normally derived from the caller's authentication context; the server always restricts results to the caller's domain.

number.description: Phone number search. The value is converted to a regular expression and matched (`~`) against the pre-computed search number, or against destination, from_number and to_number when it is not available. Matches the number on either side of the call. If omitted or empty, no filter is applied.

direction.description: Call direction, exact match: `inbound` or `outbound`. If omitted or empty, both directions are returned.

answered_at.description: Range filter (inclusive) on answer time (`answered_at`), Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC). IMPORTANT: applied only when BOTH `from` and `to` are provided; otherwise ignored. Unanswered calls are excluded when active.

missed.description: If true, returns only missed calls: inbound, never bridged to an operator (`bridged_at` is null), not hidden from the missed list, and whose parent call was not bridged. Omit for no filter; do not send an explicit false.

stored_at.description: Range filter (inclusive) on the time the call record was persisted to history (`stored_at`), Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC). IMPORTANT: applied only when BOTH `from` and `to` are provided; otherwise ignored. Useful for incremental synchronization.

id.description: Array of call IDs (UUID, OR logic). Exact match on `id`. Empty array = no filter.

transfer_from.description: Array of call IDs (UUID, OR logic). Returns calls that were created by a transfer FROM one of the given calls (`transfer_from`). Empty array = no filter.

transfer_to.description: Array of call IDs (UUID, OR logic). Returns calls that were transferred TO one of the given calls (`transfer_to`). Empty array = no filter.

dependency_id.description: Root call ID (UUID). Returns the full dependency tree of the call: all descendants reachable recursively through `parent_id` (child legs) or `transfer_from` (transfers). The root call itself is excluded. Required when `timeline` is true. If omitted, no filter is applied.

tags.description: Array of tags (OR logic). Matches calls having at least one of the given tags (array overlap). Empty array = no filter.

variables[string].description: Custom call variables filter. Matches calls whose stored variables (JSONB payload) contain ALL given key/value pairs (containment, AND logic between pairs; exact, case-sensitive values). Empty map = no filter.

amd_result.description: Array of answering machine detection (AMD) results (OR logic). Matches either the classic AMD result or the AI AMD result. Passing an empty string element ("") additionally matches calls without a detection result. Empty array = no filter.

fts.description: Full-text search over call transcripts (PostgreSQL plainto_tsquery semantics: all words must be present, order-insensitive). Implicitly requires the call to have a transcript. Ignored when `has_transcript` is false. If omitted or empty, no filter is applied.

directions.description: Array of call directions (`inbound`, `outbound`). Not applied by the GetHistoryByGroups query; use the singular `direction` field for direction filtering.

has_transcript.description: Tri-state filter by transcript presence. true = only calls with a transcript (further narrowed by `fts` if set); false = only calls without a transcript; omitted/null = no filter (unless `fts` is set).

agent_description.description: Case-insensitive pattern search (ILIKE) in the agent's wrap-up description of the queue attempt OR in any call annotation note. If omitted or empty, no filter is applied.

owner_id.description: Array of user IDs (OR logic). Matches calls where the given user is the direct owner of the leg (`user_id`) only; unlike `user_id`, participation in other legs is not considered. Empty array = no filter.

grantee_id.description: Array of grantee IDs (OR logic): the authorization subject (user/role/gateway identity) that the call was placed on behalf of. Exact match on `grantee_id`. Empty array = no filter.

amd_ai_result.description: Array of AI-based answering machine detection results (OR logic). Matched against `amd_ai_result` in lowercase. Empty array = no filter.

talk.description: Range filter (inclusive) on talk time (`talk_sec`) in SECONDS, i.e. the time the parties were actually connected, excluding ringing and hold. Omitted bound = open-ended.

rated.description: Tri-state filter by quality evaluation. false = only calls that have NOT been evaluated; true = only evaluated calls, optionally narrowed by `rated_user`, `rated_by`, `score_required` and `score_optional`. Setting any of those filters without `rated` also restricts results to evaluated calls. Omitted/null = no filter.

rated_by.description: Array of user IDs of evaluators (supervisors/QA) who created the evaluation (OR logic). Restricts to evaluated calls. Empty array = no filter.

score_required.description: Range filter (inclusive) on the evaluation score of REQUIRED (mandatory) questions (`score_required`). Restricts to evaluated calls. Omitted bound = open-ended.

score_optional.description: Range filter (inclusive) on the evaluation score of OPTIONAL questions (`score_optional`). Restricts to evaluated calls. Omitted bound = open-ended.

rated_user.description: Array of user IDs of the evaluated agents/operators (OR logic). Restricts to evaluated calls. Empty array = no filter.

contact_id.description: Array of CRM contact IDs (OR logic). Exact match on the call's linked contact (`contact_id`). Empty array = no filter.

schema_id.description: Array of routing schema (call flow / IVR) IDs (OR logic). Matches calls that executed at least one of the given schemas (array overlap on `schema_ids`). Empty array = no filter.

has_transfer.description: Tri-state filter by transfers. true = only calls involved in a blind or attended transfer; false = only calls with no transfer; omitted/null = no filter.

timeline.description: If true, returns only the legs relevant for building a call timeline of the call tree given by `dependency_id`: transferred legs handled by a user, blind transfer legs, and legs whose parent differs from the root. REQUIRES `dependency_id`; without it the result is empty. Omitted/null = no filter.

excluded_queue_types.description: Array of queue types to EXCLUDE from the result. Calls whose queue type is in the list are hidden; calls that did not pass through a queue are always kept. Empty array = nothing excluded.

engine.SearchHistoryCallRequest.description: Filter, sort and pagination parameters for searching completed calls (CDR). Filters are AND-combined; array filters are OR-combined internally. Timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC); ranges are inclusive.
engine.SearchHistoryCallRequest.title: SearchHistoryCallRequest

next.description: Indicates whether another page of results exists.

google.protobuf.NullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.
